name: Steal a Drink
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Steal A Drink

You can earn money offline💸

👍 Like the game and join the group
How to Play:


Buy Drinks - Use your money to purchase unique Drinks & Sodas and build your collection. 


Steal Drinks  – Challenge other players and Steal their Drinks to grow your empire.


💸 Generate Money – Your Characters earn money over time. The more you have, the faster you grow!
🔥 Rebirth – Reset your progress in exchange for powerful bonuses and faster earnings.

all in-game assets are entirely original
